Name: Style
Description: The style of the crack pattern generated by the node.

Flubs.Name: Normal
Flubs.Description: The default style that creates cracks that gentle slope inward.

Flubs.Name: Hard
Flubs.Description: The edges of the cracks are not refined and may show aliasing. This may be useful if the softer edges create artifacts in other nodes.

Flubs.Name: Classic
Flubs.Description: The default style from previous versions of Gaea. This is creates very thin cracks without a slope curve.

Name: Octaves
Description: The number of crack pattern sets to generate.

Name: Scale
Description: The overall size of the cracked pattern.

Name: Depth
Description: The depth of the cracks. It also widens the cracks.

Name: Jitter
Description: Control the offset of the cracks between symmetrical and chaotic.

Name: Warp Strength
Description: The strength of the warp distortion applied to the cracks.

Name: Warp Size
Description: The size of the warp distortion applied to the cracks.

Name: Seed
Description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process.

Name: Scale X
Description: The non-uniform scale on the X axis.

Name: Scale Y
Description: The non-uniform scale on the Y axis.
